name: pm-china-work
description: The Chinese workplace pack: weekly and monthly reports (周报), the year-end review (述职 / 年终总结), the promotion defence (晋升答辩), the 复盘 project review, PRD reviews (需求评审), job-level comparison (职级对标), official documents to GB/T 9704 (公文), a jargon translator that turns 互联网黑话 into plain words (and back, for fun), and Feishu docs, DingTalk logs and WeCom announcements, written in Chinese to the conventions managers expect
